title: Merge verified Progress-217 release into the deployment branch
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Почему ты вдруг начал делать в отдельных ветках? Можешь делать, если тебе удобно, но в конце обязательно мерж в основную ветку, из которой я выкладываю

scope.goal: Merge the already approved and verified Progress-217 source-release history into the exact deployment branch codex/reference-average-available-windows, preserve all newer deployment-branch work, validate the merged result, and push that branch so the user's ordinary deployment contains the correction.
inScope: Require the deployment branch to remain exactly codex/reference-average-available-windows, preserve product tip 1892a926fdf64ce9c4f19a1a82fc70aa7bc1053b as an ancestor, and allow only requirement-contract approval/history merge commits before the implementation merge.
Merge codex/progress-purge-217 through exact tip 6cec2351fe83ed3aefa6ea8d99f92ff5159519d1 with a non-squashed merge so approval commits 1d5361cc, a735d5ff, and 510b036b remain in history.

Preserve every current deployment-branch product change and the complete approved Progress-217 behavior: exact 217 catalog/seed exclusion, preservation of the three referenced sources and three retained LowerEnter owners, and absence of automatic database/history cleanup.

Resolve only the three conflicts proven by the aborted no-commit merge: retain both histories in Codex/Contexts/ContextPolyCopyTrader.md, Codex/Contexts/History/ContextPolyCopyTrader-2026-08-19.md, and Codex/Contexts/History/ContextPolyCopyTrader-2026-08-20.md. Inspect the automatically merged README to confirm that both current release documentation and the staged Progress-217 wording remain.
Run the complete Release solution build, focused Progress catalog/seed/reference tests, and the isolated PostgreSQL double-initializer history-preservation tests against the merged source.

Obtain independent semantic review, complete requirement validation and diff checks, create the merge commit, then immediately perform the repository workflow finalization by pushing that exact commit normally to the existing deployment-branch upstream and comparing local/upstream identities.
Record the standing workflow rule that future feature branches must be merged into the user's deployment branch before reporting them ready to deploy.
outOfScope: Changing the exact 217 target set, Progress behavior, retained references, or database cleanup semantics.
Deleting or rewriting any local/product strategy row or history, executing cleanup SQL, backing up a database, or reclaiming database space.
Deploying or restarting the service; the user performs the ordinary deployment after the pushed merge.
Resolving an unexpected product-code conflict by preference. Any conflict outside the three proven context/history files is a fail-closed blocker requiring a revised contract.
Squashing, rebasing, cherry-picking away approval history, force-pushing, or changing another branch.
scope.periodOrFilter: Exact Git range from merge base d27b5f385c8d4848f3facc0d799c0cae2f9e6540 through deployment tip 1892a926fdf64ce9c4f19a1a82fc70aa7bc1053b and Progress tip 6cec2351fe83ed3aefa6ea8d99f92ff5159519d1; no database data period.
scope.firstVerification: Read-only verify branch identity, clean status, upstream divergence, merge base, unique commits, and exact conflict paths before any merge.

Only the three proven context/history conflicts are manually combined; README must retain both auto-merged documentation changes, and any unexpected product conflict stops the merge.

verification.expected: Both histories and all exact Progress-217 semantics are present with no unapproved product conflict or cleanup path.

acceptanceCriteria: The complete Release solution build finishes with zero errors.
Focused exact catalog, seed, retained-reference, Child Progress, and processor tests pass.
A fresh isolated PostgreSQL fixture proves two schema initializations preserve existing stopped target rows and representative structured history exactly and create no cleanup marker.

acceptanceCriteria: A non-squashed merge commit is created on codex/reference-average-available-windows after the approval parent commit and all verification.
The configured upstream is origin/codex/reference-average-available-windows, the pre-merge local history is a strict fast-forward of that upstream, and no force push is used.

The handoff identifies that exact commit and instructs the user to redeploy it before any history cleanup.

verification.expected: The pre-commit publication path is verified as normal and non-force; the exact completed merge is then pushed and equality-checked immediately after it exists.
